name: Wan2.1-T2V-Realistic
description: Wan 2.1 text-to-video workflow tuned for photorealistic output. Optimized for lifelike, high-detail scenes.

prompt.description: Main text prompt describing the photorealistic scene to generate.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to steer away from unwanted qualities.
negative_prompt.default: worst quality, low quality, blurry, distorted, cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, 3d render, cgi

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. -1 for random.

fps.description: Frames per second for the output video.
